name: rhombus-partner
description: MSP and reseller tooling for managing multiple Rhombus client organizations. Provides a client-selector agent, fleet-ops agent, and client-onboarding agent; a partner CLI skill, cross-client reporting skill, and onboarding skill; six /rhombus-* multi-org commands (clients, client-switch, audit-clients, client-alerts, client-devices, fleet-report); active-client session state via .claude/rhombus-partner.local.md; partner-aware command validation and session-init hooks; and the shared CLI auto-installer.
